summary: Focused testing of iteration-2 follow-up features: E.164 phone validation (backend+frontend), reCAPTCHA v3 stub, slowapi rate-limit on POST /api/leads, and i18n scaffolding with EN-only language switcher. 5/5 new backend tests pass. Full regression suite still green: 16/16. Frontend landing + language switcher + estimator step-2 phone validation + full E2E lead submission with normalized E.164 all working. Verified admin dashboard shows new leads with normalized +61412345678 numbers. Verified no google.com/gstatic reCAPTCHA scripts loaded (site key empty). One frontend bug: the inline error element with data-testid='whatsapp-error' is MISSING — `whatsappError` state is declared/set in Estimator.jsx but never rendered in JSX; only the toast fires. Blocking behavior still correct (user cannot advance to step 3 with invalid phone).

action_items: Render the inline `whatsapp-error` element in Estimator.jsx Step 2 so the data-testid required by the spec is satisfied (also improves a11y — screen readers may miss the toast).
critical_code_review_comments: Estimator.jsx: `whatsappError` state is dead — set but never rendered (see ui_bugs above).

backend/server.py verify_recaptcha() uses a synchronous `requests.post` inside an async request path. Currently harmless because RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY is empty and the function returns early, but when keys are configured this blocks the event loop; consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor.

slowapi Limiter uses in-memory storage which is per-worker (uvicorn spawns multiple workers behind gunicorn). As noted in the request, 429s therefore appear inconsistently — for production consider a Redis-backed storage_uri (`Limiter(..., storage_uri='redis://...')`) so limits are shared across workers.
LEAD_RATE_LIMIT is read at import time; changing the env var requires a full restart (not just hot reload). Acceptable but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_Phone leads created with whatsapp_number=+61412345678 during E.164 tests; visible in admin dashboard. Safe to leave; searchable by 'TEST_Phone' or by email prefix TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New feature suite at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (phone validation, recaptcha stub, rate limit). Run both suites via `pytest backend/tests/ -v` from /app. Frontend Estimator uses data-testid='step1-next', 'step2-reveal', 'step3-submit', 'balance-input', 'first-name-input', 'email-input', 'whatsapp-input'. Language switcher: 'lang-switcher' + 'lang-option-en'. reCAPTCHA site key intentionally empty in /app/frontend/.env — GoogleReCaptchaProvider is conditionally NOT mounted (verified 0 google.com/recaptcha requests).
rca of the issue: Missing whatsapp-error inline element: developer added state + setter and toast handler but forgot to add the JSX render for the state; likely because the toast covered the UX requirement in isolated dev testing. Fix: single-line JSX addition; no logic change required.
